title: Capivara Clicker
description:
Welcome to the Ultimate Capybara Clicking Experience!

Get ready for a premium, highly addictive idle clicker game with a vibrant, modern neon aesthetic and a rich Brazilian twist!

🇧🇷 Cool Brazilian Upgrades

Grow your economy by purchasing authentic Brazilian upgrades, including:

• Cafezinho Coado: Brew fresh local coffee to speed up your clicks.

• Pão de Queijo: Warm cheese bread to automate your income.

• Vira-lata Caramelo: Adopt the legendary Brazilian Caramel Dog.

• Taça do Hexa: Raise the legendary World Cup trophy!

💡 Neon Achievements for Profile Decor

Unlock 77 beautifully crafted Steam achievements! Spell out words, decorate your profile showcase with numbers, symbols, and Circular 3D Glassy flags, or show off the cool Capybara avatar badge.

✨ Key Features:

• Procedural Graphics: High-definition neon graphics and grid scanlines.

• Bilingual Support: Fully playable in Portuguese and English.

• Synthesized Audio: Clean sound effects dynamically generated.
description_short: Click the cool capybara, purchase unique Brazilian upgrades like Pão de Queijo and Guaraná, and unlock beautiful neon achievements to customize your Steam profile! A premium, casual idle clicker game with vibrant aesthetics.
